commits.change: Generated outbound Context services and ordinary collection-interface projection. Its original Windows/Linux gates remain failed.
Reject mistyped identities through empty scoped signatures. Its original Windows gate remains failed.
Repair nested reference nullability and ignored-member mapping; restore complete service publication; align documentation extraction and generated constructor documentation; migrate real consumers.

findings.proof: Generated source event codecs accept nullable nested elements and reject required null elements in both property orders. Saved-model contract packages deliver both DTOs through the typed On listener over the real Host.
A legal JsonIgnore same-name member no longer changes the active nullable property contract in the source Host codec. The narrower standalone DTO collision refusal is retained.
Existing qualified event output and actual carrier unused-uplink regressions remain in the complete frozen source gate.

retained: One common declaration model and STJ metadata authority
Existing Connection, Cordis tracing, adapter lookup, scoped identity and generation lifetime
Existing configuration and installation operation owners
Explicit authored-schema codecs and narrower standalone DTO refusals
retired: Root-only annotation of a reused STJ reference
Last-member-wins nullability mapping including always-ignored members
Publication of an empty scoped service before method installation
Treating traced proxy reference identity as service identity
Documentation drift caused only by disabled XML output

publicUse.authors: RemoteMethod/RemoteEvent declarations and existing JSON contexts; no new author annotation or model format.
publicUse.generatedBoundary: CreateDeclared(metadata, query); query returns a declaration-use Id and Nullable rule within one codec. Regenerate existing repository consumers; no compatibility overload.
publicUse.browser: mountRemote(owner, connection, adapters), then getRemote(caller, namespace) with typed scoped calls; mount disposal owns the contribution and borrows the Connection.
publicUse.dotnetEvents: Generated On listener from the source declaration or independently packaged saved model.
publicUse.ordinaryData: The existing framework collection projection accepts IEnumerable<T>, ICollection<T>, IReadOnlyCollection<T>, IList<T> alongside lists, arrays and string-key dictionaries; no arbitrary generic implementation execution.
